pr_title: Fix toggling after scrolling resulted in blank space
pr_body:
Fix #63334.

Previously, the data used by `update_scrollbars()` and `_update_dimensions()` in their calculations depended on each other, which caused some problems.

Now, the calculation of `child_max_size` is put into `get_minimum_size()`, as the containers call `update_minimum_size()` before calling `queue_sort()`.

issue_context.title: Wrong ScrollContainer behavior with always visible scrolls when children don't need scrolling
issue_context.body:
### Godot version

38c6611

### System information

W10

### Issue description

With scroll auto, child container can be expanded to full size:
![godot windows tools 64_DE0LdwRscH](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/2223172/151561680-262b975a-c6a2-46a0-82a3-599156bdcd72.gif)

Buf if scroll is always visible, the child will be shrunk to minimum size and doesn't fit to the whole container anymore:
![godot windows tools 64_Fy9N7il6kn](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/2223172/151561768-a474fe7c-f40f-4b3d-bb89-daeefece53ca.gif)
(notice how bottom of the panel is cut)

### Steps to reproduce

1. Add ScrollContainer with some scroll set to always visible
2. Add some child container that doesn't need to be scrolled
3. Observe

### Minimal reproduction project

[control.tscn.txt](https://github.com/godotengine/godot/files/7959248/control.tscn.txt)
Press any key to see the bug.

review_comments: For `ScrollContainer`, `queue_sort()` will eventually cause `update()` to be called, and all information can be confirmed at once, so there is no need to call `update()`.

Mainly consistent with the one here:
https://github.com/godotengine/godot/blob/3f39625399d8a5ef118341e47500f31f21b11581/scene/gui/scroll_container.cpp#L274-L280

I'm not sure if this case actually exists.

We actually have one instance in the editor where this happens:
https://github.com/godotengine/godot/blob/cc09dc92c8ee06255a158d81533d35c6d2e8d31e/editor/animation_track_editor.cpp#L6268
Since `update_scrollbars() is called` first, the appropriate `max`/`page`/`value` will be set. So there is no need to reset to `0` here.

When `*_scroll_mode` is `SCROLL_MODE_SHOW_NEVER`, it is always invisible. As a result, in this case, the resizing cannot be performed. 

Didn't notice before due to display issues with `clip_contents` (#63707).
